Game Overview

Xmas Snow Challenge - Maze Puzzle is a puzzle game built around help Chris the elf navigate delightful, snowy mazes this Christmas Eve. Swipe through whimsical paths, overcome tricky obstacles, and smartly use portals to reveal an enchanting winter wonderland. Solve charming puzzles with strategic thinking and enjoy festive fun, one snowy path at a time!
